content.value: Write regular expression for the following languages:

i) The set of all strings of ${ \mathfrak { O } } ^ { * } { \mathfrak { s } }$ and i's such that no prefix has two more ${ \boldsymbol { 0 } } ^ { \bullet } { \boldsymbol { s } }$ than $\mathbf { \nabla } _ { 1 } \mathfrak { s } ,$ not two more 1's than $\mathfrak { O } ^ { \bullet } \mathfrak { s } .$

ii) The set of all strings of $\boldsymbol { 0 } ^ { \bullet } \boldsymbol { \mathsf { s } }$ and 1’s whose number of ${ \boldsymbol { 0 } } ^ { \bullet } { \boldsymbol { \mathsf { s } } }$ is divisible by 5 and number of 1's is even.
iii) The set of all strings of ${ \boldsymbol { 0 } } ^ { * } { \boldsymbol { \mathsf { s } } }$ and 1's whose $1 0 ^ { \mathfrak { t h } }$ symbol from the right end is 1.
